headline: English Communication Coach
summary: Licensed English teacher with seven years in senior high school, moving into corporate English coaching. I design and run speaking and writing sessions, assess learners' English, and proofread and write materials. For the past year I have coached call centre applicants on weekends and want to do this full time.

experience.title: English Communication Coach
bullets: Coach small groups of call centre applicants on pronunciation, listening and handling calls.
Assess each learner's speaking at the start and end of a four-week course; 70% passed their account interview.

experience.title: Senior High School English Teacher
bullets: Teach Oral Communication, Reading and Writing, and English for Academic Purposes to Grade 11 and 12.
Plan lessons and assessments for four sections of about 40 learners each.
Proofread and write the school's publications and certificates.

education.credential: Bachelor of Secondary Education, major in English
